findings.title: New createWorkingDir duplicates existing resolveWorkingDir helper
findings.why_it_matters: The working-directory path is now worked out by two named functions in the same file. The startup directory creation goes through createWorkingDir, and the per-run cleanup goes through resolveWorkingDir. If one changes (for example trimming whitespace from GIT_WORKING_DIR, or reading it with GetEnvOrFile the way other settings are read) and the other doesn't, soba could create one directory at startup and then look for or remove a different one after each backup. Because the diff pulled this code into a standalone helper, it could have called resolveWorkingDir(backupDIR) at no extra cost and kept a single source of truth.
findings.suggested_fix: In createWorkingDir, replace the four-line GIT_WORKING_DIR/default block with `workingDIR := resolveWorkingDir(backupDIR)` and drop the now-redundant comment. Behavior is identical: both read os.Getenv(envGitWorkingDir) and fall back to filepath.Join(backupDir, workingDIRName).
evidence: internal/backup.go:476-478 -- if workingDIR == "" { workingDIR = filepath.Join(backupDIR, workingDIRName) }
internal/backup.go:140-146 -- func resolveWorkingDir(backupDir string) string { if w := os.Getenv(envGitWorkingDir); w != "" { return w }; return filepath.Join(backupDir, workingDIRName) }
internal/backup.go:52 -- workingDir := resolveWorkingDir(backupDir) (the canonical helper's existing caller in runProviderBackups)

residual_risks: displayBitBucketStartupConfig still gates only on BITBUCKET_EMAIL, while collectProviderBackupResults and checkProvidersDefined now share bitbucketAPITokenDefined()/bitbucketOAuthDefined(). OAuth-only BitBucket users get backups but no BitBucket startup-config log lines. This was already the case before the diff, and the PR says log output is unchanged, so the diff keeps it on purpose. Aligning the gate is a follow-up.
